The proposal is rejected before execution. Preserve all six accepted requirements, the sole public query input, real sequential product visits (at most ten), the real workbook write/output path and unconditional Browser cleanup. Use the existing contracts and TaskPlan only; do not change permissions, limits or accepted work.

Correct the three TASK_CONDITION_TYPE diagnostics: requires must be boolean. Where the intended check is a nonempty string, express an explicit supported comparison against the empty string. Do not use a string as a condition, remove a required check or invent a success value. Preserve scope visibility and explicit exports.

This validation specifically exercises the refreshed Browser-owned complete acquisition contract. Use browser_get_content format observation_complete instead of bounded raw HTML. Complete acquisition returns observationSnapshot.pages with records and original completeness metadata, not flat content. Use its exact inspected schema. Each observation must succeed and be complete before extraction; do not manufacture completeness. The Browser handles generation recovery internally. Use at most 200 records and 24000 characters per page and at most 100 pages. No manual stale-cursor retry, extra navigation or larger allowance.

Process every returned page and record. Use existing independent extract/each over bounded record collections to produce consumer-specific compact observed candidates; preserve order, grouping, exact action references and all relevant observations. A record can return no candidates only after checking irrelevance. Do not invent booleans, ranks, labels or missing business values in extract mode. Global classification/selection remains explicit interpret over compact facts only, never over all raw pages or a large raw envelope. Select at most ten products globally, not ten per page. Required product data must come from actual visited product observations; missing data stays explicit, not replaced with listing facts.

Keep conditional consent clicking based on an observed authorized control and reacquire a fresh complete snapshot after it. CAPTCHA and unavailable search/results remain explicit blockers, not fabricated product rows or successful empty work. Keep document formatting over compact observed product records, then the real write operation and cleanup. Return a complete revised plan with requirements unchanged.
